brief: The viewport forks the seeded world, and `?seed=` therefore does not name a world. Measured on HEAD, seed 42, `__reseed()` then `__warp` in 5 s steps: bit-identical through simT 120, then `people` reads 49 at 1600x950 against 48 at 390x844 at simT 125, and by simT 415 `cloud` is 0.166 / 0.781 / 0.471 and `raining` false / true / false at 1600x950 / 390x844 / 1200x720. The first divergence is a POPULATION count, so something inside simStep draws an extra `R()` on a branch that reads a screen metric — the window, `cellW`/`cellH`, `gview`, a pad, an `inView`, a world-edge test in screen space. Find it, name it, and make the simulation pure of the observer: the frame is a WINDOW on the town, never a fork of it. Then leave a gate behind that would have caught this on day one. Why now: this is the artifact's headline promise, and it also means every multi-framing gate the loop owns has spent 175 iterations comparing two different towns — the visual gate shoots four framings and the census, motion and filmstrip baselines are pinned at one size, so a 'visual PASS at 4 framings' has never been the evidence it reads as. Expect a large diff and take the swing: 150-300 lines is welcome, and re-pinning every baseline is part of the job, not a failure of it.
successLooksLike: A new permanent gate — `probes/seed-identity.mjs` — loads the page at every framing in shoot.config.json plus two arbitrary viewports, `__reseed()`s, warps to at least three pinned instants, and asserts the full census scalar set is IDENTICAL across all of them. It FAILS on HEAD (quote the failing numbers) and PASSES on the candidate. The three-viewport reading above collapses to one world. Every other baseline is re-pinned and the re-pin is stated.
avoid: Do not close this by making the census report only viewport-independent fields, or by pinning the gate at one framing — the bug is the FORK, not the report. Do not fix it by seeding per-viewport. If the divergence turns out to be legitimate (a spawn that genuinely should depend on visible area), that is a finding, not a pass: say so, and make the gate assert the invariant that IS true. LAWS: any new draw reshuffles the whole seeded world, so read the census for collapse rather than delta, and keep each branch on the half of [0,1) it owned.
